whiteListedEntities.description:
The entities of a certain Type which this data diagnostic logic should be run on.
Gets "OR"ed with the filter on this data diagnostic during evaluation.

blackListedEntities.description:
The entities of type srcType which this data diagnostic logic should not be run on.
Gets "AND"ed with the filter on this data diagnostic during evaluation.

title:
Type which should be mixed onto a persistable type that extends {@link DataDiagnostic}. Used to
maintain black and white lists for the diagnostic's scope.
name: EntityRelatable
